children: RNS Number : 3072T  Bank of Nova Scotia  03 September 2026
3 September 2026
The Bank of Nova Scotia
(LEI:  L3I9ZG2KFGXZ61BMYR72)
Notification of Admission
The following transferable securities of The Bank of Nova Scotia (the "Issuer") have been admitted to trading on 3 September 2026 on the London Stock Exchange's main market:
€1,250,000,000 Callable Fixed to Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2030 (XS3489324114) (the "Series 479 Notes")
and
€500,000,000 Callable Fixed to Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2034 (XS3489353998) (the "Series 480 Notes")
issued under the Issuer's U.S.$40,000,000,000 Euro Medium Term Note Programme (the "Programme").

Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Series 479 Notes is only available on the basis of the combination of the final terms for the Series 479 Notes published by the Issuer on 1 September 2026 (the "Series 479 Notes Final Terms") and the base prospectus for the Programme dated 7 July 2026 (the "Base Prospectus").

Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Series 480 Notes is only available on the basis of the combination of the final terms for the Series 480 Notes published by the Issuer on 1 September 2026 (the "Series 480 Notes Final Terms") and the Base Prospectus.
The Base Prospectus is available for viewing on the Issuer's website at: BNS-EMTN-Update-2026-Base-Prospectus-FINAL.pdf
DISCLAIMER - INTENDED ADDRESSEES

Please note that the information contained in the Prospectus, the Series 479 Notes Final Terms and the Series 480 Notes Final Terms, may be addressed to and/or targeted at persons who are residents of particular countries (specified in the Prospectus) only and is not intended for use and should not be relied upon by any person outside these countries and/or to whom the offer contained in the Series 479 Notes Final Terms and the Series 480 Notes Final Terms is not addressed.  Prior to relying on the information contained in the Series 479 Notes Final Terms and the Series 480 Notes Final Terms you must ascertain from the Prospectus, as supplemented by the Series 479 Notes Final Terms and the Series 480 Notes Final Terms, whether or not you are part of the intended addressees of the information contained therein.

The Notes have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act").  Subject to certain exceptions, the Notes may not be offered, sold or delivered in or into the United States or to or for the account or benefit of US persons (as defined in Regulation S under the Securities Act).  No public offering of the Notes is being made in the United States.

MiFID/UK MIFIR professionals/ ECPs-only / No PRIIPs KID/disclosure document - Manufacturer target market (MiFID/UK MIFIR product governance) is eligible counterparties and professional clients only (all distribution channels). No PRIIPs key information document (KID) or disclosure document required by the FCA Product Disclosure Sourcebook has been prepared as not available to retail in EEA and the UK.
